about.aboutDescription: Steam Home is an educational team project of the game store, inspired by Steam. The application provides a catalog of games, search and filtering, a shopping cart and admin tools.
about.goalDescription1: Easy viewing of games with collections, categories and detailed pages.
about.goalDescription2: Quick search by name, filters and sorting for a comfortable selection.
about.goalDescription3: Unified style, responsive screens and user-friendly experience.
about.teamDescription1: Frontend infrastructure setup, project architecture, interface integration.
about.teamDescription2: UI/UX, design system, screen design and user experience.

processing.title: Data Processing
paragraphs: Steam Doma does not require user registration or use analytics or advertising tracking.
Technical information, including IP addresses, may be processed by our hosting provider to deliver and secure the website.
If you contact us by email, your email address and message are processed to respond to your inquiry and retained only for as long as necessary for that purpose or to comply with legal obligations.
Providing information by email is voluntary.

hosting.title: Hosting
paragraphs: The application is hosted on Microsoft Azure in the Brazil South region, Brazil.
Microsoft may process technical information necessary to provide cloud hosting services. Hosting-related processing is subject to the applicable Microsoft Data Protection Addendum.

storage.title: Cookies and Local Storage
paragraphs: Cookies and local storage are used exclusively to remember your selected language and interface theme.
You can remove these preferences through your browser settings.

rights.title: Your Rights
paragraphs: Under applicable data protection legislation, you may request access, correction, deletion, or portability of your personal data, restrict or object to its processing, and withdraw consent where applicable.
To exercise your rights, contact alex.ovchinnikov.dev@gmail.com.
You may also lodge a complaint with Uruguay's Unidad Reguladora y de Control de Datos Personales (URCDP).
